name: mcp.xfa.tech
description:
XFA is a device-trust platform for BYOD. It verifies each device's security at every login — OS version and patch status, disk encryption, antivirus, firewall, screen lock, and more — so only healthy devices reach your applications, with no MDM and without managing the device.

This connector lets your AI assistant reach your own XFA organization. After you sign in with your XFA account, you can ask in plain language and get answers straight from XFA:
    - Your organization, and your own user and role
    - Devices and their security posture (those active in the last 30 days), including which are non-compliant, out of date, or missing a control
    - A compliance summary: verified vs unverified devices, compliant vs not, users without a verified device, and exposure to ransomware / phishing / data-breach vulnerabilities
    - Posture trends over time
    - Your policies
    - Software version and vulnerability (CVE) data for the titles XFA tracks (browsers, operating systems, PDF readers, Slack, the XFA app, mobile)

Learn more at https://xfa.tech.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.xfa.tech to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.xfa.tech to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.xfa.tech/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.xfa.tech MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.xfa.tech provides these MCP tools: get_compliance_summary, get_current_user, get_cves_for_version, get_device, get_latest_version, get_organization, get_posture_trends, get_software_version_info, list_devices, list_policies, and list_versioned_software_catalog.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.xfa.tech?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.xfa.tech in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
mcp.xfa.tech requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.xfa.tech is developed by XFA. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
